The Middle Kingdom period in India encompassed how many eras, and what were these?
options: It encompassed three eras: Classical or Ancient India, early Medieval India from 500 CE onwards, and the Medieval period.
It encompassed two eras: Classical or Ancient India, from the Mauryan Empire until the end of the Gupta Empire in 500 CE, and early Medieval India from 500 CE onwards.
It encompassed a single era: Classical or Ancient India, from the Maurya Empire until the end of the Gupta Empire in 500 CE.
The Middle Kingdom period encompassed no chronological era/s but is an amorphous span of time.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (It encompassed two eras: Classical or Ancient India, from the Mauryan Empire until the end of the Gupta Empire in 500 CE, and early Medieval India from 500 CE onwards.) है।
